exercises.why: **расположен** — расположи́ть (perfective): to place, to dispose, to arrange, to set; to gain, to win over; to dispose, to be favourable, to be conducive. Wiktionary: рас- + положи́ть.

exercises.why: From Wiktionary: полага́ться — to rely on, to pin one's hopes on, to bank on; уложи́ть — to lay; расположи́ть — to place, to dispose, to arrange, to set; предположе́ние — assumption.
**предположение** — предположе́ние: assumption; hypothesis, supposition, guess, speculation, conjecture, surmise; presumption; presupposition. Wiktionary: предположи́ть + -е́ние.
